text-output-base.instruction: Rate how well the model answered the question about this chart.

response.prompt: Rate the quality of the model's answer

parameters.taskPrompt: Add visual annotations to highlight three significant waves: (1) Add a vertical shaded grey region at the left side of the chart with label 'Jan. 2021 peak' at the top marking the initial peak period, (2) Add a vertical shaded grey region in the middle-right area with label 'Delta wave' at the top marking the Delta variant surge around August-October 2021, and (3) Add a vertical shaded grey region at the far right with label 'Omicron wave' at the top marking the Omicron surge in late 2021 to early 2022. The labels should be positioned above the chart area. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations to highlight the most costly disasters: (1) Label the tall dark red bar around 2005 as 'Hurricane Katrina' with '$161 billion', (2) Label the components of the tallest bar (2017) on the right side: 'California wildfires $18 billion' at the top, 'Hurricane Irma $50 billion', 'Hurricane Maria $90 billion', and 'Hurricane Harvey $125 billion' for the different segments, (3) Add a '$300 billion' scale reference at the top of the chart. Position the cost labels to the right of the bars with lines or arrows connecting them to their respective segments. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add a vertical dashed line at 2023 with label 'Projected' at the top to indicate where projections begin, (2) Add a label 'Proposed cuts' pointing to or inside the lighter purple area (the proposed cuts portion) in the projected years. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Label the orange line as 'India' near the middle of the chart, (2) Label the teal/blue line as 'China' near the middle of the chart, (3) Add a shaded region or bracket around the steep decline in China's fertility rate (late 1970s to early 1980s) with label 'One-child policy', (4) Add a horizontal dashed reference line at fertility rate 2.1 (approximately) with label 'Approx. fertility rate for a stable population' on the right side, (5) Add 'Projected' label with an arrow at the top where projections begin (around 2020), (6) Add a callout near India's line around 2020 saying 'India's fertility rate ensures a roughly stable population'. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add a vertical reference line at the current credit level (around $2,000) with label 'Current 2022 credit' at the bottom, (2) Add a label 'Expansion for older children' pointing to the middle pink segment, (3) Add a label 'Expansion for younger children' pointing to the rightmost light pink segment. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotation: Add a shaded region or bracket with the label 'WEEKEND' highlighting the May 30-31 period (Saturday-Sunday) when protests were at their peak (approximately 180-200 locations). Return the annotated image.
Add the following annotation: Add a callout with an arrow pointing to the most recent recession band (at the far right, around 2020) with the label 'Covid-19 recession'. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add a legend or labels identifying 'China' for the red bars and 'U.S.' for the blue bars in the upper left area, (2) Add a vertical dashed reference line at 2012 with label 'XI JINPING'S TERM' at the top, indicating when Xi Jinping's leadership began and China's patent applications accelerated dramatically. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotation: Add a vertical dashed reference line at 2012 with label 'XI JINPING'S TERM' at the top, indicating when Xi Jinping began his anti-corruption campaign which led to the dramatic increase in disciplinary actions. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add column headers above the Fox News bar: 'Democrat' on the left, 'Independent' in the middle, 'Republican' on the right, (2) Add segment labels within the Fox News bar: 'Lean', 'Weak', 'Strong' to identify the intensity levels, (3) Add segment labels within the MSNBC bar at the bottom: 'Strong', 'Weak', 'Lean', (4) Add a callout box pointing to the Fox News bar saying 'Fox viewers skew to the right—but most are not committed Republicans'. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add vertical reference lines to mark three distinct eras with boxes/regions: first era from 1956 to ~1965, second era from ~1966 to ~1976, third era from ~1977 to ~1999, (2) Add a label inside or above the third era (1977-1999) saying 'Restricted to songs in national language' to indicate the rule that limited English songs during that period. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add a label 'Market expectations' in the upper right area above the forked projections, (2) Label the grey projection line 'At: March 1st' with a dot at its endpoint around 5.25%, (3) Label the light blue projection line 'March 21st' with a dot at its endpoint around 4.0%, (4) Add a light grey shaded region behind the forked projection area to indicate the forecast period. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Add a vertical reference line at approximately 1996 with the label 'OxyContin painkiller introduced', (2) Add a numbered callout '1. Deaths of despair were declining until the opioid epidemic hit' with an arrow pointing to the early 1980s dip in the All line, (3) Add a numbered callout '2. The downward trend ended earlier among middle-aged whites' with an arrow pointing to the mid-1990s where the Whites line starts rising, (4) Add a dashed line labeled 'Pre-1990s trend' extending from the 1979 starting point of the All line forward to show what the trajectory would have been without the opioid crisis. Return the annotated image.

Add the following annotations: (1) Label the highest outlier dot (approximately 30% at price ~5,000) as 'Hayrullah district', (2) Label the second highest outlier (approximately 20% at price ~5,000) as 'Ismet Pasa', (3) Add a label '↑ More damage' on the right side of the chart near the y-axis to indicate the direction of increasing damage. Return the annotated image.
